correctness.rationale: Reverse coordinate orders give two geodesics with disjoint interiors when the original distance is at least two; precisely the faulty endpoint distance changes. At scale two the relative chain complex is the augmented link complex shifted by two, and the coordinate three-cube spheres give unit-coefficient basis images in its third relative homology. The pair sequence and simply connected homology Whitehead argument establish the faulted wedge type. In the persistence comparison the positive-degree stages below radius three have free homology and no continuing maps; they split as interval summands over the integers, with a common tail not assumed free. Over fields the whole comparison is one of barcodes.
residual_risks: No general assertion about torsion in the common integral tail; finite field calculations cannot resolve torsion.
